                                       ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION I . Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current M 1-2, Limited Manufacturing/Business Park
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. I-K in the area bounded by:

              West Carroll Avenue; the public alley ne.xt west of and parallel to North Pulaski
              Road; the public alley next south of West Carroll Avenue; and a line 200.0 feet
              west of and parallel to North Pulaski Road, as measured along the south line of
              West Carroll Avenue

to those of a C3-2. Commercial. Manufacturing and Employment District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.



Address: 4013-19 West Carroll Avenue
                                          NARRATIVE AND PLANS
                                         TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
                                         4013-19 West Carroll Avenue
The Proiect

The subject site is improved with a two-story manufacturing building that includes approximately 20,708 ground
floor square feet and is approximately 30.0 feet in height. The property includes no parking. The current use of
the property is manufacturing use.

GAR PARK 1 LLC (the "Applicant"), proposes to rezone the property to convert the current manufacturing use
to a commercial use to allow the rental of construction equipment at the existing building. The existing building,
floor area, and height will be maintained. No additional parking will be added.

To allow the proposed project, the Applicant seeks a change in zoning classification for the subject property from
a from a Ml-2, Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District to a C3-2, Commercial. Manufacturing and
Employment District. This change of zoning classification is being sought through the Type 1 rezoning process
of section 17-13-0302-A of the Zoning Ordinance.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area:                        14,788 square feet

FAR:                             1.40

Height:                          30.0 feet approximately
